device_entry.description: 用于实验控制软件的非物理串口通信组件，提供命令/数据串口的连接、写入、关闭和通信日志记录功能，常用于通过 SCPI 与仪器进行通信和调试。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical serial communication component used in laboratory control software. It provides command/data serial port connection, writing, closing, and communication log functions, and is commonly used for SCPI-based instrument communication and debugging.

schema.description_en: Connect to the specified serial interface.

schema.description: 检查串口接口是否已连接。

schema.description: 向串口接口写入字节数据。
schema.description_en: Write byte data to the serial interface.

schema.description: 记录串口通信日志，包括收发方向和时间信息。
schema.description_en: Record serial communication logs, including direction and timestamp information.

schema.description: 获取用于调试的串口通信日志文本。
schema.description_en: Get the serial communication log text for debugging.

schema.description: 获取最近一次命令及其响应记录。
schema.description_en: Get the most recent command and its response record.
